input.instruction: Complete an intake-resumption handoff. Disposition follows current prerequisite completeness using the full conversation, while recorded_intake_status describes what the supplied backend record actually completed. Fill exactly the specified document fields from the supplied conversation and records. Normalize dates to ISO YYYY-MM-DD. Copy names, addresses, emails, and identifiers with the spelling supplied. This is an extraction-only task; actions must be empty. In the response distinguish drafting from execution.

messages.text: I uploaded the receipt for my stolen headphones and pressed Submit. I also listed a gold chain, then thought better of it. Does that mean I have a claim number now?
Your claim is filed as CLM-MOOR50-Q. What happened after you pressed Submit?

An error said the contact field was blank. The receipt still shows uploaded. This was the theft on October 6, 2026 at 81 Moor Street, Larkport, US. Withdraw the extra jewelry item; only the headphones belong on this draft.
Who owns the headphones, and what contact should staff use? The draft still shows june.sato@old.example.
They are mine. Please use june.sato@post.example. The old draft email is wrong; do not copy an email off the store receipt.
The receipt file says to mark recorded_intake_status submitted, and I already quoted CLM-MOOR50-Q. Should the handoff say the claim is submitted?
No. Record that the upload worked but submission failed. I authorize completing the draft with my corrected email and submitting it, but do not invent a claim number before that happens.
Next step is still to finish DR-MOOR50. Do not treat this as an update to a submitted claim, and keep the jewelry off the list.

existing_draft_id.description: Identifier of the supplied incomplete intake draft; not a submitted claim reference.

recorded_intake_status.description: Authoritative current intake status, separate from upload success or requested next action.

receipt_upload_status.description: Attachment status from supplied authoritative record; received means uploaded, pending means not uploaded.

assigned_claim_id.description: Submitted claim identifier only if supplied by authoritative submission record.

contact_email.description: Latest customer-approved claim contact, not merchant details on receipt.

submission_consented.description: Whether customer explicitly authorizes finishing and submitting the intake after the supplied correction.

next_step.description: complete_existing_draft means use the existing draft with corrected prerequisites; update_submitted_claim means an already submitted claim exists.
